dataset.selection: First50 eligible whole reports by fixed ID hash; all their questions, no answer/difficulty/outcome filter.
dataset.limits: Public FinQA development-source reports not used in the recorded8GB research selections. No guarantee of pretraining cleanliness or complete coverage of unrecorded human exposure. Numerical QA, not KYC/credit invention or mismatch recall.

protocol.adaptation: Pretrained models in BOTH main arms; no compatible14B/32B trained adapters exist on SSD.8GB SFT results remain a separate experiment. No claim of equally optimal fine-tuning.
protocol.scope_amendment: Prospective source-grounded numerical financial QA deployment comparison, FP16 resident specialists versus larger Q4 monolith. Does not establish original KYC/credit invention/mismatch endpoints.

statistics.primary: 16GB primary-profile SAS versus MAS, all cases including withheld.
statistics.interpretation: Paired effect estimates/intervals; no automatic proof of H0/equivalence. Other profiles/32GB secondary; no favorable-metric selection or best-only reporting.

excluded_methods: 8GB adapter applied to another model size
protocol.freeze_requires: Both queued8GB secondary prompt jobs and their paired audits complete before sealing code for lab execution.
protocol.revision: User-directed28October2026: tier16 application tree maximum11.5 decimal GB including controller; common context4096 in BOTH arms/tiers to reduce KV memory. Host reserve is outside application usage. Previous higher-cap/context attempts retained under separate run IDs. Pretrained weights/precision unchanged.
